resources.string: During active growth, hair matrix cells divide in the follicle. Some of the new cells become part of the keratinized shaft as it moves outward. This demo assumes a constant rate and does not model the hair cycle. The rate and time are invented for teaching and do not measure or predict individual hair growth.
Added shaft length (mm) = example growth rate (mm/d) × elapsed demo time (d).
Demo time to add 1 mm: %1$s d
